title: Declare what each assessment is for
statement: Before judging a course or assessment, declare its purpose (teaching, practice, mastery gate, diagnostic), judge it by that alone, and set pass marks only on checks that gate progress.
example: One course keeps its 24-item mastery gate, set at 90%, apart from a growth test that has no 90% threshold and gates nothing.
detail: The assessment packet has the product type declared first, as formative, mastery, diagnostic, summative or cold measurement, and bars calling a diagnostic score a grade, since diagnostics route study under uncertainty (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g3-reading-v2-feedback-2026-07-16/assessment-item-agent.md`). A course validator fails a check-bearing screen that declares no product type, because the type decides which criteria apply (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g3-reading-v2-feedback-2026-07-16/tooling/ti-courseplans-2169d1f/docs/standards/course-json/tools/course_validate.py`), and the evaluator gap list names the same declaration (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0093-evaluator-gap-analysis-inceptbench-academics-2026-07-09.qmd`). The course checklist and the staged assessment standard keep the 24-item mastery gate apart from the growth measure, which uses cold passages, scores raw out of 40 with a band and is never gated on, and they call its predictive claim a design intent until a linking study runs (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/CHECKLIST.md`, `grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/docs/standards/assessment-design.md`). The purposes also include placement, a final summary and a transfer measure on unseen material, and the declaration should come with the assessment's full specification. Pass marks belong only on checks that decide progress.
against: The stamps prove the 90% gate, not a 24-hour delay: the platform does not enforce that delay, and no elapsed-time evidence was captured (the same two files). The gap analysis lists the declaration as a second-tier gap, a check the evaluator does not yet make (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0093-evaluator-gap-analysis-inceptbench-academics-2026-07-09.qmd`).

evidence.quote: Product declaration: formative, mastery, diagnostic, summative, or cold measurement.

product_type -- required to gate which criteria apply.
product-type declaration: comprehension curriculum vs MAP-practice determines applicable criteria;
These are **two distinct instruments** — do not conflate them.
the 24-item mastery GATE (`masteryThreshold:90`) is DISTINCT from the MAP-equivalent proxy (cold passages, raw/40+band, `gating=false`, no 90 threshold). Don't conflate.
The predictive claim ("does well here → does well on MAP") is **a design intent, not a measured result**, until the linking study runs.
